content: Homage to the Blessed One, the arahant, the Fully Awakened Buddha(1) Inclusion and exclusion (2) what is excluded by what is included (3) what is included by what is excluded (4) what is included by what is included (5) what is excluded by what is excluded (6) association and dissociation (7) what is dissociated from what is associated (8) what is associated with what is dissociated (9) what is associated with what is associated (10) what is dissociated from what is dissociated (11) what is associated with and dissociated from what is included (12) what is included and excluded by what is associated (13) what is associated with and dissociated from what is excluded (14) what is included and excluded by what is dissociated.(1) The five aggregates (2) the twelve sense bases (3) the eighteen elements (4) the four truths (5) the twenty-two faculties (6) dependent origination (7) the four foundations of mindfulness (8) the four right efforts (9) the four means to accomplishment (10) the four jhānas (11) the four measureless states (12) the five faculties (13) the five powers (14) the seven factors of awakening (15) the noble eightfold path (16) contact, feeling, perception, volition, consciousness, decision, attention.Inclusion in terms of three, exclusion in terms of three, association in terms of four, dissociation in terms of four.Same kind, different kind.The whole of the Enumeration of Phenomena is the matrix for the Discussion of Elements.In how many aggregates, bases and elements is the aggregate of form included? The aggregate of form is included in one aggregate, eleven sense bases and eleven elements. In how many is it excluded? It is excluded from four aggregates, one base and seven elements.In how many aggregates, bases and elements is the aggregate of feeling included? It is excluded from four aggregates, eleven sense bases and seventeen elements.In how many aggregates, bases and elements is the aggregate of perception included?
